edges.meaning: Deletion invalidates agent snapshot, activity, run counts and task history; registered active observers may refetch; task pages use limit 200 and cursor.

Label change marks archived pages/lookup/facets stale synchronously, then awaits cancellation before invalidation per prefix; active enabled observers may refetch. Lookup requires groupId; archive factories disable retries.
Unversioned label event with previously revisioned cache invalidates issue queries and byIssue labels; label observer requires issueId.

semantics: Incoming WS payload is not an HTTP request. QueryClient and standard library WeakMap/Map/array operations are boundaries; own helpers remain effects.

Auxiliary revisions keyed by QueryClient and workspace:issue:projection; record maximum. Older (<) projection dropped; undefined admitted. Positive auxiliary revision invalidates loaded owners with absent/older revision without advancing full Issue revision.

Full reconcile deletes auxiliary entries <= full revision; restores exact stale flags if newer auxiliary exists. Snapshot merge rejects <; updater coordinator and children accept strictly > or undefined. Unversioned event with any cached revision invalidates issues workspace prefix and returns.
Owner exact invalidation scans detail, bucketed, flat pages, table rows, children and Gantt. Predicates require present owner and optionally absent/older revision.

Label derivative flat prefix requires object query-key part with nonempty label_ids array. Property window workspace prefix requires nonempty object properties or string sort_by starting property:. Array parts excluded.

Creation bucket insertion requires known status category; unknown category invalidates loaded list key. Creation also invalidates my/flat/table/groups/Gantt/sidebar, project when assigned, parent children/progress when parent exists.

Update derives changed flags from server metadata or cached diff; coordinator stale keys flushed, derivatives and sidebar invoked, table always invalidated; old/new parent children and progress/batched children conditional.

Label event starts archived-inbox refresh before version fallback; patch labels updates snapshots/inbox label_ids/byIssue, with byIssue revision <= rejected; records labels auxiliary revision. Metadata and properties replace full bags; committed handlers invalidate sorted windows and table/my; property adds children/groups/property windows.
Duplicate change normalizes nullish values then invalidates issue,next,prev duplicates if changed. Delete calls cleanup then duplicates/groups/projects invalidation.
Invalidation can refetch enabled active matching observers; inactive observers may fetch later. No guaranteed count. Local reads/writes/removals do not themselves invent HTTP.
